title: MS Teams Channel Config
description: Configuration for the Microsoft Teams channel adapter. Uses the Bot Framework Connector REST API with OAuth2 client-credentials grant. Send and inbound webhook receive are both implemented; inbound activities are JWT-validated against the Bot Framework JWKS, and their attachments are parsed. Downloading attachment bytes (fetch_media) is not implemented.

credential_handle_app_id.description: Credentials-store key for the Azure AD application (client) ID.

credential_handle_app_password.description: Credentials-store key for the Azure AD client secret (app password).

service_url.description: Bot Framework service URL for the tenant (e.g. https://smba.trafficmanager.net/amer/). Required for send; obtained from the first inbound activity.

token_url.description: OAuth2 token endpoint. Defaults to the live Microsoft endpoint; override only to point the adapter at a local fixture.

openid_metadata_url.description: OpenID Connect metadata document supplying the inbound JWT signing keys. Defaults to the live Bot Framework endpoint; override only to point the adapter at a local fixture.
